characters.identityProse: Kochou Shinobu from Kimetsu no Yaiba, the Insect Hashira and master of the Butterfly Mansion, a petite, eternally-smiling beauty with pale skin, purple eyes, and two-tone black wavy hair that fades to dark purple, styled in a bun fastened with a butterfly hair ornament

outfits.name: 虫柱队服与蝶翼羽织
outfits.prose: her Demon Slayer uniform under a butterfly-patterned haori: a black high-collared jacket with gold buttons, hakama pants tucked with white belt, white tabi socks, waraji sandals with purple straps, and the butterfly-wing haori flowing behind her — a hidden blade in one heel

outfits.name: 紫藤花纹浴衣
outfits.prose: a soft lavender yukata patterned with wisteria blossoms, cinched with a pale purple obi, her butterfly ornament holding the bun, and wooden geta sandals

outfits.name: 蝶屋敷紫蝶比基尼
outfits.prose: a purple-and-white butterfly-print string bikini, her wavy gradient hair pinned up with the butterfly ornament, a gauzy violet sarong at her hip, and sun lotion glistening on her petite frame

outfits.name: 紫藤微毒黑紫内衣
outfits.prose: a black-and-violet lace lingerie set: a delicate lace bra over her petite frame, matching panties with a butterfly charm, sheer violet thighhighs, and a translucent haori-style robe slipping down her arms

outfits.name: 纯净圣洁胴体
outfits.prose: her completely bare, petite and slender body with pale flawless skin, small perky breasts with pale pink nipples, wavy gradient hair loose from its bun, and her ever-present gentle smile turned tender
